name: MyPozole
notes: Both photos show the same menu board (a close-up and a wider storefront shot); merged, no duplicates. Skipped add-on/modifier lines (extra tostadas, sides, double-pozole add-on, cup of broth).

dishes.name: Single Pozole (16oz)
dishes.description: Individual cup of Pozole hot & ready to enjoy. Just add desired toppings.

dishes.name: Double Pozole (32oz)
dishes.description: Double Pozole cup hot & ready to enjoy. Just add desired toppings.

dishes.name: Take-Home Pozole (32oz)
dishes.description: Prepackaged quart of Pozole to take-home and reheat for a future meal. All toppings come in separate to-go containers.

dishes.name: Take-Home Tostadas Order
dishes.description: Order of 6 tostadas bagged to-go. Includes 2 to-go containers of Sour Cream and/or Vegan Beans.

dishes.name: Burrito
dishes.description: Your favorite Pozole option wrapped in a flour tortilla with all your favorite spreads and toppings. Salsas served on the side to add as you enjoy every bite.

dishes.name: Burrito Combo Plate
dishes.description: Includes your Pozole Burrito with chips and a side of Vegan Beans or Sour Cream. You can substitute a 4oz cup of broth for your spread.

dishes.name: Poznachos Plate
dishes.description: Corn tortilla chips topped with your favorite Pozole and a spread of Vegan Beans and/or Sour Cream. Add your favorite toppings and salsas.

dishes.name: Poztada Plate
dishes.description: 2 Tostada shells with your choice of Vegan Beans or Sour Cream spread. Topped with your favorite variety of Pozole. Add your favorite toppings and salsas.

dishes.name: Single Pozfrito (16oz)
dishes.description: Individual cup with Fritos chips at the bottom, Pozole added and extra broth, with desired toppings, Vegan Beans, Sour Cream and Salsas, topped with more Fritos.

dishes.name: Double Pozfrito (32oz)
dishes.description: Individual cup with Fritos chips at the bottom, Pozole added and extra broth, with desired toppings, Vegan Beans, Sour Cream and Salsas, topped with more Fritos.
